shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat (balcony-rule targeting, mortars on map coords, real-time rendering, sound and shake, Combat Extended bridge with high-ground suppression/accuracy), and NPC arrivals/departures over ridge routes and tunnel mouths behind per-category toggles. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553 (still on the window-3 build); window 4 prepped for publish but NOT uploaded, back in build mode.

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, `(w, 1, bandCount*Slot)`; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)*64`; 64-alignment load-bearing.
**The one insight:** `Region.Neighbors` is topological; Portal wormholes conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temp/vacuum; the jobified pathfinder cannot cross a synthetic link → segmented movement.
**⚠⚠ `CanReach` = "with stairs"; pathfinder = "walking now"** (§34, §40).
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK GENERALISES TO NEITHER UTILITIES NOR COMBAT; where it meets combat it looks like a combat bug (§41i); it is why exits leaked before §43.**
**⚠ THE GUTTER:** shells scatter into it (§41f), radial searches reach it (§41i), skyfaller offsets cross it (§41b), spanning shoot lines walk through it (§41k), **CE rounds would COLLIDE through it (§44 - the CE origin remap is mandatory, not cosmetic)**.
**⚠ THE VIEW IS DOWNWARD-ONLY; physics, combat rendering, sound and traffic are symmetric.**
**⚠⚠ ANISOTROPY BREAKS EVERY RAW DISTANCE TEST.** `BandOf` CLAMPS. Window-4 count: TEN+ instances.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, ten shapes — anchor/field/noise/extent/aspect/scalar/foreign-writes/radius-vs-gutter/list-sweep/raw-participant-maths. `ABBandLocal.cs` is the canonical FIELD rewrite. Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — 126/128 (7 cap) · **190/192 (4)** · 254/256 (2); one efficient height per 64-step; 200 is the number to avoid; plan persists between colonies.

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA — segmented at `StartPath`; hops strictly decrease; multi-hop ✅. TWO CARRY TRIGGERS, must agree on the ending (§33c/h). **ONE DESCENT RULE + ONE SANCTIONED SIBLING (`ABShaft.ColumnOpen`)** shared by ballistics/relays/flecks/audio. 4d closed the last single-band corner (realtime things).

# 8b. DEPTH SHRINK — loose contents only; terrain never; no shrink for flecks/relayed things.

# 9. GENERATION COST — FillRock tracks HILLINESS (superlinear in band size); RAINFALL dominates Plants. **⚠⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES TEST VALIDITY - INCLUDING COMBAT (test OUTDOORS).** 9g queue: basement rock suppression first.

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove innocence by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. One change per experiment. Diagnostic before theory; after five failed theories, SHIP THE INSTRUMENT.
**⚠⚠ COUNT EMITTERS/HOMES/POPULATIONS/DERIVATIONS/SENSES/DIRECTIONS/ENGINE STACKS.**
**⚠⚠ SUPPRESSING A DRAW IS SAFE; SUPPRESSING A BAKE IS NOT** (§29b). `Visible` is re-read every frame, so un-suppressing self-heals. A mesh/cache persists, and the dirty system is not listening to our globals.
**⚠⚠ A SKIPPED `Regenerate` IS STILL MARKED CLEAN** (§29b): `Section.TryUpdate` sets `Dirty = false` after the call and cannot see that a prefix returned false.
**⚠⚠ A MUTABLE GLOBAL IN A SKIP CONDITION IS A PROMISE TO DIRTY ON EVERY TRANSITION** (§29b). `ABGuard.*` is NOT config - ten call sites trip it, settings re-arm it, load resets it.
**⚠⚠ A REMAP CAN NEUTRALIZE YOUR OWN DOWNSTREAM HOOK** (§44 suppression reads the LAUNCHER - the untouched coordinate source).
**⚠⚠ SURFACE-ONLY-BY-ACCIDENT IS NOT A RULE** (§43). **⚠⚠ SECOND ENTRY POINTS, NOT FACTION CHECKS** (§41i). **⚠⚠ HELPERS REIMPLEMENTING RANGE/BEARING/ANCHOR MATHS ARE INVISIBLE TO VERB PATCHES** (n=8). **⚠⚠ "DECLINE TO HELP" IS NOT "DENY"** (§41c, both engines). **⚠⚠ MOVEMENT SYMPTOMS CAN BE RANGE CHECKS; THINK TREES DISGUISE FAILED NODES.** **⚠⚠ THE MISS PATHS ARE A SECOND FEATURE.** **⚠⚠ ONE-PAWN-TYPE REPORTS AREN'T TYPE-SPECIFIC. ⚠⚠ DERIVED ANSWERS CAN'T BEAT SOURCES. ⚠⚠ BLIND INSTRUMENTS. ⚠⚠ TELEPORT EXITS RE-DISPATCH. ⚠⚠ thingIDNumber STATICS. ⚠⚠ ONE GESTURE, THREE PATHS. ⚠⚠ REVERT-FIRST. ⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT'S ALREADY BUILT/DOCUMENTED.**
**⚠ THE USER'S EYE BEATS THE AGENT'S ARITHMETIC** (§41l) - **AND A PLAYER'S CODE REVIEW BEATS BOTH** (§29b). **⚠ FLAVOR NEVER BREAKS AN INCIDENT: FALLBACKS ARE LOAD-BEARING** (§43). **⚠ PARTICIPATION BY ALLOWLIST** (§43 latches; §44 Prepare-gates). **⚠ A SHADOW CAN BE DRAWN WHERE NOBODY LOOKS. ⚠ HONESTY RULES CAN BE REPLACED BY MORE HONEST RULES. ⚠ EXACT-MATCH KEYS ON SCATTERED VALUES MISS ON EVERY MISS; TOLERANCES COVER THE WORST LEGAL SCATTER. ⚠ FOUR CASES, ONE DEFECT. ⚠ IMPOSSIBLE FEATURES MAY BE FREE. ⚠ GUARDS ARE PER-CONSUMER (§29b: the loud-catch lesson was written in a doc comment 40 lines above the silent catch that still had it). ⚠ COUNT CONSUMERS (§29b: `GlowReportAt` reads the baked mesh and never consults `Visible`). ⚠ A ROUNDING-ERROR OPTIMISATION IS NOT WORTH A CORRECTNESS HAZARD - DELETE IT (§29b: 0.002 ms/frame). ⚠ FUNNEL BRANCHES LIE UNEQUALLY. ⚠ COPY GOES STALE; NEVER UPDATE AHEAD OF VERIFICATION - THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY (the §31 ledger is the worked example). ⚠ RECORD FALSE POSITIVES (keyed do-not-fix list now: vanilla keys NoPath/Indoors/IndoorsUnroofed/Outdoors; LanguageData root; AB_Tab* via DrawTabButton; AB_Cat* via DoArrivalCategory's parameter). ⚠ DOCUMENTED ROUNDING ERRORS CAN BEAT FRAGILE FIXES.** *(One-liner archive unchanged: thresholds/markers/reverts/guards/agreement/not-same/arithmetic-signatures/call-sites/three-copies/four-defects/loop-direction/stateless-inputs/radius-reasons/no-sync-pathfinds-in-draw/user-premise/burst-methods/one-claim/delete-unmattering-work/overlay-agreement/five-returns/config-expressiveness/quantised-params/heaviest-budgets/wrong-axis-models/lying-UIs/n=2/half-ordering/read-suspect-data/mod-x-regressions/whole-subsystems/predicate-conditions/two-resolvers/n-mods/foreign-defs/dependency-lists/enums/decompile-versions/compat-is-deletion/false-comments/burst-fps/0.0ms/downstream-errors/dispatch-x-calls/appended-catch.)*
**Patching.** Wrap DATA; patch PRODUCERS; INNER METHODS over wrappers; **no foreign types in patch signatures (§44: vanilla/Unity types + index params, TargetMethod by name, Prepare validates SHAPE - a CE rename degrades one seam and the combat report names it)**; prefix releases in FINALIZERS; `[ThreadStatic]` latches; RE-ENTER WITH CORRECTED INPUTS; REIMPLEMENT WHEN GUARDS SIT AHEAD; POSTFIX-CORRECT COSMETICS; BOX/SETVALUE/UNBOX structs (CE's report is a CLASS); REBUILD IMMUTABLE-ANCHOR STRUCTS; gate LIFETIME or OBSERVER; **SUPPRESS AT `Visible`, NEVER AT `Regenerate` (§29b)**.

## 29b. THE LIGHTING-BAKE SKIP (player-reported, FIXED BY DELETION)
`Patch_LightingOverlay_ABSkipBakeOnBanded` prefixed `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay.Regenerate` and returned false whenever `Banded(map) && ABGuard.On(Rendering)`, so vanilla's overlay stopped baking a mesh that the sibling `Visible` postfix had already stopped drawing. It shipped in window 3. A beta player picked it at random, read it, and filed two correct objections; a third defect turned up on verification.

- **Bought:** 3.92 ms per 2000 frames over 46 regenerations = **~0.002 ms/frame**.
- **Defect 1 - marked clean while empty.** `Section.TryUpdate` sets `sectionLayer.Dirty = false` AFTER calling `Regenerate`; it cannot see a prefix skip. Vanilla's layer sat clean with zero verts and `sectRect`/`firstCenterInd` never initialised.
- **Defect 2 - the skip condition was a mutable global with no dirty hook.** `ABGuard.Rendering` is tripped by ~10 rendering call sites, re-armed from settings, reset on load. On any flip BOTH patches stopped applying together: vanilla's overlay went visible holding the empty mesh, and with `relevantChangeTypes = Roofs | GroundGlow` a settled colony re-dirties rarely. Symptom: guard trips → map draws with NO lighting overlay until the player builds something.
- **Defect 3 - an uncounted consumer.** `LudeonTK.EditWindow_DebugInspector` calls `GlowReportAt`, which reads the baked mesh's `colors32` directly and never checks `Visible`. Unbaked mesh = `IndexOutOfRange` per frame with the glow report open.
- **Plus** a bare `catch { }` swallowing everything, in the same file whose `Visible` patch carries a doc comment explaining why that is wrong.
- **Resolution: deleted, not repaired.** Keeping it would have cost a shared ownership predicate, a deferred `WholeMapChanged(Roofs | GroundGlow)` on every guard transition, and a `GlowReportAt` guard - ~40 lines of hazard for a rounding error. A ⚠ tombstone comment sits where the class was so no future window re-adds the "obvious" optimisation. The `Visible` suppression (the load-bearing half) is untouched. Build green, 0 warnings.
